title: Tera Jhula Jhualoo'n Aaa Asghar
body:
Tera Jhoola ,
Jhulaoo'n Aaa Asghar !
Tere Ge Soo'n ,
Sajaoo'n Aaa Asghar !
Tera Jhula Jhulaoo'n Aaa Asghar !
Haye Asghar Haye Asghar ,
Haye Asghar Haye Asghar !
(Tera Jhula Jhulaoon Aaa Asghar Tere Ge Soon Sajaon Aaa Asghar
Tera Jhula Jhulaoon Aaa Asghar)
1) Teri furqat ka gham sahoo'n kaise
Khak par chod kar jiyoo'n kaise ,
Tujh ko loari sunaoo'n Aaa Asghar
2) Soona jungle hai raat andheri hai
Zalzale hain dhuwa'n hai aandhi hai ,
Raat kaise bitaoo'n Aaa Asghar
3) Jale jhoole ki lakdiyaa'n lekar
Jaou'ngi jab vatan mere dilbar ,
Tujhku kaise bhulao'n Aaa Asghar
4) Chumlo'n aa mai tera khooshk gala
Tera sadqa utaroo'n aaa beta ,
Naaz tere uthaoo'n Aaa Asghar
5) Apne ashko'n se khat me Sughra ne
Tujhse milne ki baat likhkhi hai ,
Aaa vatan leke jao'n Aaa Asghar
6) Kaise jungle me chod doo'n tanha Khouf hai shaam ke darindo'n ka ,
Aaa jigar se lagoo'n Aaa Asghar
7) Yaad maa ki tujhe sataye gi
Khak par neend kaise aaye gi ,
Tera bistar lagoo'n Aaa Asghar
8) Khoon ke ashk aankh Wamiq ki
Sunke Zahid ye bain roane lagi ,
Boli maa jab jhulaoo'n Aaa Asghar
